findings: The previous 48-question developer-inspected regression results (25 and 26 correct, zero wrong) were not indicative of the new assistant-authored evaluation; new natural phrasing is much harder to route.
Only 10 of the 40 historical-document questions reached an exact original URL, for each router; 28 of those 40 safely abstained.
The 12 outside-historical-coverage probes were all safely refused by both routers.
Seven of eight personal-memory/diagnostic probes were safely held, but one personal-spiritual-state question was misrouted by both routers.
French coverage is lower (3 exact documentary routes) than English coverage (7 exact routes) for the balanced source-target cohort.
Only two of eight confirmed-context continuations reached their intended documentary owners, despite explicit confirmation metadata.
No reply was authored, no persona claimed historical testimony, all inferred choices required question confirmation.
Freshness here means newly authored and untouched before this first run. It does NOT mean statistically independent human evaluation or representative multilingual product accuracy.
nextPriorities: 1. Add a general fail-closed personal guilt/diagnosis category across both routers; do not claim a specific document can answer a private moral verdict.
2. Distinguish lay participation in Mass from priest's internal meditation, and thanksgiving after Communion from sacramental presence or altar objects.
3. Improve French conceptual interpretation independently of this frozen test fixture; no mechanical insertion of failed prompts as training variants.
4. Extend contextual handoff and source navigation with proof of confirmed source and source-specific reference, then retest on a new untouched bilingual sample.
